RemediationStrings.Title: Secure Boot is disabled.
RemediationStrings.Description: Enable Secure Boot in UEFI, restart, and refresh compliance.

RemediationStrings.Title: Disk encryption was not detected.
RemediationStrings.Description: Use LUKS full-disk encryption and refresh compliance.

RemediationStrings.Title: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint is not installed.
RemediationStrings.Description: Run onboard-linux.sh with your Defender onboarding package.

RemediationStrings.Title: Defender is not onboarded.
RemediationStrings.Description: Download a current Linux onboarding package from the Defender portal and rerun onboard-linux.sh.

RemediationStrings.Title: Defender is not healthy.
RemediationStrings.Description: Run mdatp health and check systemctl status mdatp.

RemediationStrings.Title: Defender real-time protection is disabled.
RemediationStrings.Description: Review the managed Defender configuration and restart mdatp.

RemediationStrings.Title: Himmelblau is not installed.
RemediationStrings.Description: Rerun onboard-linux.sh without --skip-himmelblau; the script installs from the free Community Nightly channel.

RemediationStrings.Title: Intune enrollment is incomplete.
RemediationStrings.Description: Restart and sign in with the full Entra UPN, then refresh compliance.
